title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: New-Money Promotion Terms
content:
Three money market tiers of the Savings & Money Market Accounts family carry a promotional yield for fresh funds brought to the bank. The terms of that promotion, and the funding window every tier records, are set out here.

## Promotion terms

| Tier | Promotional APY | Length of promotion, in calendar months from opening | New money required (USD) | Largest daily balance paid at the promotional rate (USD) | Days after opening in which new money counts toward the requirement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 |
| Statement Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 |
| Goal Builder Savings | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 30 |
| Money Market Account | 3.50% | 6 | 25000.00 | 250000.00 | 30 |
| Premier Money Market | 3.90% | 6 | 25000.00 | 500000.00 | 30 |
| Private Client Money Market | 4.10% | 12 | 100000.00 | 2000000.00 | 30 |

## What the terms mean

- The **promotional APY** is paid on qualifying new money during the promotional period and takes the place of the base APY on that promotional share of the balance.
- The **length** runs in calendar months counted from the opening date.
- The **new money required** is the sum that has to arrive within the funding window for the promotional rate to switch on at all.
- The **balance ceiling** is the most of a day's balance that can earn the promotional rate.
- The **funding window** is a number of calendar days after the opening date; deposits inside it count toward the new-money requirement.

## Tier comparisons

**Which tier has the longest promotion?** Private Client Money Market, at 12 months; the other two promotional tiers run 6 months.

**Does the 30-day figure on Starter Savings mean it has a promotion?** No. The window is recorded for every tier, but the three savings tiers offer no promotional rate for it to feed.

**A hypothetical Premier Money Market owner brings 24000.00 of new money inside the window. Is the requirement met?** No; it falls short of 25000.00.
